patch_description: Restructure the filter as a modular pipeline built around an adaptive constant-velocity Kalman filter instead of per-window regression. A two-stage architecture is used: (1) a warmup stage that initializes the filter state over the first window-1 samples, and (2) a streaming stage that emits one output per remaining sample, preserving the original output length contract. The Kalman filter's process noise is adapted online from the innovation (prediction error) magnitude, so it stiffens in quiet regions (heavy smoothing, fewer slope changes and false reversals) and loosens quickly at genuine dynamics (low lag, high tracking accuracy). Unlike the sliding regression, this is O(1) per sample with no per-window fits, giving both better smoothness and efficiency. Helper modules (predict, update, adapt) are separated for maintainability.
